assertions.name: alpha_em_prefers_proton_anchor
assertions.source: q_alpha within 0.245 ppb of proton pin vs 11.8 ppb of muon pin

description: Inverts the pure-q0 alpha_EM fixed-point form for the q0 that reproduces CODATA (q_alpha), then compares to the proton and muon pins. Finding: q_alpha is ~0.245 ppb from the PROTON pin but ~11.8 ppb from the MUON pin (= the mu-p tension) — alpha_EM is a THIRD EM-sector cross-check preferring the proton anchor, agreeing with m_p against the muon. No coefficient fitted (only q0 solved for); scope-(a).

interpretation.note: alpha_EM (EM sector) agrees with proton pin to sub-ppb; muon is the outlier (mu-p tension)
